## Summary

Which skill(s) does this touch, and what changed?

## Type of change

- [ ] New skill
- [ ] Fix to an existing skill
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Other (describe below)

## Checklist

- [ ] `SKILL.md` frontmatter (`name`, `description`) is accurate
- [ ] `README.md` updated if a skill was added or its purpose changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or client-confidential data included

## Additional context

Anything reviewers should know.
